units.source_text: 驹子也躲闪一旁，让这些水泵过去。

en.t: Komako also stepped aside and let the pumps pass.

units.source_text: 她找到岛村，两人又一块走起来。

en.t: She found Shimamura, and the two of them started walking together again.

units.source_text: 站在路旁躲闪水泵的人，仿佛被水泵所吸引，跟在后面追赶着。

en.t: The people who had stood by the roadside to avoid the pumps seemed drawn to them and hurried after them.

units.source_text: 如今，他们两人也不过是奔向火场的人群当中的成员罢了。

en.t: By now, the two of them were merely part of the crowd rushing toward the fire.
